caption.text: Part 2 of KAFKA PRODUCERS. Most Kafka data loss is not a broker problem — it is a `send()` whose return value nobody read. This handbook walks the whole producer path: the two threads behind one call, what each `acks` level really waits for, how `batch.size` and `linger.ms` race each other, and why `enable.idempotence=true` is free correctness.
